title: Putting Together
short: Adding means joining groups to find how many in all.

blocks.html: You know how many are in a group. When two groups are put together, they make one bigger group. That is adding.

blocks.name: k-pic
blocks.cap: 3 red balloons and 2 blue balloons. Tap each one as you count them all.

blocks.html: Adding means putting groups together and finding how many in all. We write $3 + 2 = 5$ and say “3 plus 2 equals 5.”
When the groups join, nothing is lost and nothing new comes. So counting everything together tells how many in all.

blocks.title: How many balloons?
blocks.q: 3 red balloons and 2 blue balloons. How many balloons in all?

blocks.name: tenframe
blocks.cap: 4 red and 3 yellow counters together make 7.

blocks.html: For grown-ups: Use small toys: make two groups, push them together and ask, “How many in all?” Say the words “3 and 2 make 5.”
